selection: At most two finalists. Prioritize complete controls and fewer severe visual-review errors, then interval-distance, logical anomalies and repeat stability. Native JSON reliability is reported separately from schema-constrained execution. Distribution inspected for collapse, never forced uniform.
manual_review: 60 Codex diagnostic intervals; not expert gold. Changes derive from exploratory v1 diagnostics; 260-pair remainder must not be described as blinded holdout.
text_filter: Do not hard-filter solely on named entities or text-only context scores.
